Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the use of text messaging functions on publicly owned wireless devices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public records; and adding a new section tochapter 42.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature recognizes that text messaging is used in thecourse of doing public business. The legislature also recognizes thatthese messages are not retained by wireless service providers. (2) Public agencies may not use text messaging functions onpublicly owned wireless devices unless those messages may be downloadedand stored as public records.
